name: Disentangling Correlated Factors
description: A benchmarking suite for disentanglement algorithms, suited for evaluating robustness to correlated factors. Codebase for the paper "Disentanglement of Correlated Factors via Hausdorff Factorized Support" by Karsten Roth, Mark Ibrahim, Zeynep Akata, Pascal Vincent, Diane Bouchacourt.
